title: introduce-predictive-burst-quorum-and-fleet-degradation-sentinel
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Dedicated fleets sometimes experience correlated microbursts that exhaust burst tokens and cause cascaded throttling; current soft-shed behavior is reactive and can lead to SLA slippage for latency-sensitive tenants. Motivation: Provide a predictive, quorum-based gating layer that permits short-lived bursts when fleet-wide indicators forecast capacity headroom while ensuring fast fallback to conservative allocations when the prediction confidence degrades. Implementation summary: add a PredictiveBurstQuorum controller that computes per-pool quorum state from a compact time-series predictor (EWMA+seasonal correction), expose quorum decisions to the scheduler via a lightweight gate API, introduce a FleetDegradationSentinel that tracks percentile-backed utilization and triggers an immediate soft-reserve fallback, augment telemetry to emit per-tenant and per-pool burst-consumption percentiles and quorum confidence scores, and add E2E harnesses and canary rollout steps. This PR touches autoscaler, scheduler, telemetry pipeline and docs. Checklist: [x] producer-side gating logic; [x] controller + leader election; [x] scheduler hook and safe fallback; [x] telemetry schema + exporter; [x] unit and integration tests; [x] docs and operations runbook. Rollout plan: feature-flagged on Dedicated clusters; step 1: telemetry-only rollout to gather percentile baselines; step 2: enable predictive quorum in canary pool (1 cluster) for 48h with aggressive alerting; step 3: 10% traffic ramp with 7d monitoring window; automatic rollback to soft-reserve if 99th latency increases >5% or burst-utilization percentiles exceed configured thresholds. Backwards compatibility: scheduler gate is additive and falls back to previous behavior when controller absent or model unavailable. Related: ENG-9932 for algorithm tuning, PM-447 for customer SLAs.

feat: scheduler gate API and admission checks
telemetry: emit burst_usage_p50/p90/p99 and quorum_confidence fields
autoscaler: integrate degradation sentinel and soft-reserve fallback
tests: add harness for correlated microburst simulation

review_comments: Diego: High-level this looks good; two concerns: 1) how frequently do we recompute the quorum model and what is the cost on control-plane CPU? 2) what are the failure modes when model predictions are systematically biased?

Author (Aisha): We recompute every 15s by default with jitter; model.go is intentionally bounded (O(n) over short window) and we cache intermediate aggregates; added a control-plane CPU flamegraph under docs/ops for the canary. For bias: the FleetDegradationSentinel is designed to detect sustained underprediction and force soft-reserve within one window; we've added a guarded cooldown to avoid oscillation.
Clara: Please add a safety for cross-pool skew — if one pool predicts headroom but adjacent pools are saturated we should limit global burst exposure.
Author (Aisha): Added cross-pool adjacency check to quorum computation in model.go and a unit test that simulates asymmetric load across pools.
Jonas: nit: prefer 10s default recompute in high-throughput clusters; otherwise approve once CI is green.
Author: lowered default to 10s and documented tradeoffs in runbook. Thanks!
ci_checks: benchmark/perf: pass (p99 latency +0.4% in steady-state, -6% during measured microbursts)
merge_summary: Merged by squash on 2025-11-20 after 3 approvals. Reason: improves burst availability while preserving latency SLOs; rollout gated and telemetry-backed. Changelog includes new metrics and a feature flag for Dedicated clusters.
release_notes: Introduce Predictive Burst Quorum (feature-flag). Adds FleetDegradationSentinel for safe fallback to soft-reserve. New telemetry: burst_usage_p50/p90/p99 and quorum_confidence. Rollout is feature-flagged and requires canary monitoring before full enablement.
notes_for_ops: Before enabling on production Dedicated fleets: 1) ensure telemetry retention for burst metrics >= 7d, 2) configure alerting on burst_usage_p99 and quorum_confidence drop, 3) schedule canary for 48h with automated rollback hooks, 4) set max_quorum_exposure_pct default to 12% until baseline observed.
